transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It’s very nice to meet you, and thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um... I hope I’m doing this right, I just... well, I’m a little embarrassed to even say it out loud. I don't want to make a bad impression or have you think poorly of me. But... I’ve been hearing things lately. Just these very clear voices in my apartment. And sometimes when I'm out, like in empty museum rooms. It's... it's just like women whispering from behind the walls, telling me which photographs belong in the archive. 

I'm sure it's probably just my mind playing tricks on me, I know it sounds a bit silly when I say it like that... but that's what brought me in. Is that the kind of thing I should be telling you?
Have you used any cannabis, stimulants, or other recreational drugs recently?

Oh! No, goodness, no. I don't touch anything like that. I... I've never really been the sort of person to use drugs or anything illegal. 

I hope you don't think... I mean, I hope my talking about the whispers didn't make you think I was on something. I promise I'm completely sober. I really only ever have my morning tea. Is that... I hope that's alright? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and not making things confusing.
Have these voices affected your ability to work, study, or manage your daily life?

Oh... well... I try very hard to keep up with everything, I really do. I don't want to sound like I'm just letting myself go or being irresponsible. But, um... I suppose things have gotten a little difficult lately. I'm so embarrassed to even admit this out loud, please don't think poorly of me. 

It's just... I've missed a few board meetings recently. And some of my bills, which is not like me at all. I'm afraid I've sort of... well, I think I've lost the trust of some of my colleagues because of it. It actually got to the point where my cousin and, um, one of the museum administrators had to step in and take over for me. They've been helping me manage my appointments and my money, and... well, they felt I couldn't handle going to public events safely on my own right now. 

I hope it's okay that I'm sharing all this... I know it sounds like I'm a terrible mess, but I just want to make sure I'm being honest and answering your questions properly. Is... is this what you needed to know?
Have you started any new prescription medications recently?

Oh! No, no, I haven't. I haven't started any new prescriptions at all. I... I don't take anything unless a doctor specifically tells me to, I promise. I try to be very, very careful about that sort of thing. I know how important it is to follow instructions properly. 

I hope that's alright? That I haven't taken anything new, I mean. I just want to make sure I'm doing exactly what I'm supposed to be doing and not causing any extra trouble for you.
During the time you’ve been hearing these voices, have you also had a period of feeling unusually high, energized, or needing much less sleep than usual?

Oh... um... well, yes, I suppose there was a time like that recently. I hope it doesn't make me sound frantic or... or manic or anything like that. I really was just trying to be productive, I promise! 

There was a stretch where I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night. But I felt so wonderful! I was just... I was bouncing from one archive task to another, sorting through all these old documents. I just had so much energy, and I felt like I was doing such important work for the museum. 

But... well, I should be completely honest with you, shouldn't I? Even when I was feeling so energized and working so fast... I was still hearing those women's voices. And I was absolutely convinced that the museum board was secretly tracking everything I was doing. I know that sounds strange now, and I'm so embarrassed to admit it... but they were happening at the exact same time. 

I hope it's okay that I'm telling you this. I just want to make sure you have the full picture. Did I explain that clearly enough?
Have the voices or the belief that the museum board was tracking you been present continuously for at least one month?

Oh, dear... um... I really hope you won't be disappointed in me for letting it go on this long. I didn't want to make a fuss, and I kept hoping it would just sort of... fade away on its own, if I just kept my head down and worked hard enough. Please don't think I was trying to be difficult or hide it from anyone on purpose! 

But, yes... to be perfectly honest, it's been much longer than a month. The voices, and that awful certainty that people are watching my archive... it's been present for about eight months now. 

I feel so foolish admitting that out loud. I know I should have asked for help so much sooner, shouldn't I? I hope I haven't made things worse by waiting this long... I'm so sorry. Is that the information you needed? I can try to remember the exact month it started if you'd prefer, I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need.
Have there been times when the voices or beliefs were present even when your mood felt completely normal?

Oh... um, yes. Yes, I think so. I hope I'm understanding you correctly, I really want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. 

There was a period of... well, maybe several weeks, where I wasn't feeling especially energized or grand at all. My mood felt quite normal, actually! Very even and calm. But... oh, I feel so silly saying this out loud, please don't judge me too harshly... even though my mood was perfectly fine, I was still hearing those whispers in my apartment. And I... I still remained completely convinced that the arts people were monitoring my phone. 

I tried my best to just ignore it so I wouldn't be a bother to anyone, I promise. I really hope you don't think less of me for still believing all of that even when I wasn't feeling wound up. Does that make sense? Did I answer that the way you needed me to?
During this time, have you had a period of feeling depressed or losing interest in things for at least two weeks?

Oh... um... depressed? Well... no, I don't think so. I really hope that's okay to say. I know sometimes people get very sad with these sorts of things, and I don't want to sound like I'm not taking it seriously, but... I haven't really felt sad or lost interest in my day-to-day things. 

I try very hard to keep up with my routines and stay positive, you know? I didn't want to be a burden on anyone by getting all mopey on top of everything else. So, no, I haven't had a couple of weeks like that. I hope that's the right answer... I just want to make sure I'm giving you an accurate picture. Is that what you were asking?
Have the voices or the belief that the board was tracking you ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not having any mood symptoms like mania or depression?

Oh, I see... yes, I think we might have just touched on that, didn't we? I hope I'm not being repetitive and wasting your time! 

But to make absolutely sure I'm answering you properly... yes, there definitely was a time like that. It was for several weeks, actually. I wasn't feeling overly energized, or... or grand, or anything like that. No depression, either. I was just... normal. But even then, without any of those mood issues, I was still hearing those whispers in my apartment. And I was still entirely convinced that the arts people were keeping tabs on my phone. 

I feel so dreadful admitting that it went on for weeks like that without me saying anything. I just kept hoping if I acted perfectly normal, it would go away and I wouldn't have to bother anyone with it. I hope you're not upset with me for that. Does that answer your question better?
Have there ever been at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or believing people were tracking you, but you were not having any manic or depressed mood symptoms at all?

Oh... um, yes. I... I know we just talked about this, and I really hope I'm not being difficult or making you repeat yourself. I'm trying my best to follow along, I promise. 

But yes, absolutely. There was that time... for several weeks, actually... where my mood was just fine. I wasn't feeling all sped up or overly important, and I wasn't feeling down either. I was just... me. Just perfectly even. But... and I feel so embarrassed saying it again, I hope you don't think I'm completely losing my mind... I was still hearing those little whispers in my apartment. And I was still so sure that the arts people were watching my phone. 

I just... I tried to keep it to myself so I wouldn't be a nuisance. I hope that's the information you were looking for? I really want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Over the past eight months, have there been times when you were depressed or manic for most of that time?

Oh... well, I want to be completely honest with you, even though it's a little embarrassing to admit. Since I retired... which covers most of those months... the time has really been dominated by these long stretches where I just felt incredibly driven. Like... like I was chosen for something, and I absolutely could not slow down, no matter how hard I tried. 

I did have some quieter, withdrawn days here and there, but mostly it was that intense, fast-paced feeling. And... oh, I hate to say this, because I really try my best to be pleasant to everyone, but I think I was quite irritable during a lot of those stretches, too. I feel just terrible if I was difficult to be around. I hope I'm not painting too awful a picture of myself... I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need. Is that the sort of thing you were asking about?
